verdict.rationale: Unit's docs say its APIs can send and receive money over ACH, wires, and real-time payments, and that it has direct Federal Reserve connectivity. That supports wires plus some instant rail with both origination and receipt. However, the evidence never names RTP or FedNow specifically and shows no per-rail capability documentation. Missing for 10: explicit RTP and FedNow support, per-rail capability and limits documentation, API reference detail for each rail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
